name: com.costacontable/mexico-market-entry-accounting
title: Mexico Market Entry & Accounting — Costa Contable
description: Mexico accounting resources and consent-based contact requests to Costa Contable.

tools.name: costa_list_services
tools.description: List published, reviewed Costa Contable services in Spanish or English.

tools.name: costa_search_knowledge
tools.description: Search published and reviewed Costa Contable guides and corridors. Returns source and review metadata; educational information only.

tools.name: costa_compare_entities
tools.description: Return reviewed educational comparison data for S.A., S. de R.L. and SAS when available; does not determine eligibility or recommend an entity.

tools.name: costa_group_preparation_checklist
tools.description: Return reviewed general preparation checklist for an international group considering Mexico operations. Not legal or tax advice.

tools.name: costa_create_contact_request
tools.description: Send a private contact request to Costa Contable and notify its team. Call only after the user explicitly asks to contact Costa and consents to follow-up and sharing these fields. Show the user the message and https://costacontable.com/privacy/ before submission. Do not include sensitive documents. Use the same request_id when retrying the same submission.
